headline: Prime Tehachapi Land Opportunity — Ready for Your Future Build
description: A prime Tehachapi land opportunity ready for your future build. This 0.3-acre (13,068 sq ft) lot offers a blank canvas for your custom home in one of California's most appealing mountain communities. Tehachapi is known for its four distinct seasons, affordable cost of living, and growing community. Build your dream home with mountain views, clean air, and room to breathe. Buyer to verify all utility connections, zoning requirements, and building permits with Kern County.
location_context: Tehachapi is a growing mountain community in Kern County, known for its aerospace industry, wind energy, outdoor recreation, and affordable housing market. Located between Los Angeles and the Central Valley.
